summary: Dependable Self-motivated and assertive Human Resources Professional with innovative solutions and personal accountability who incorporates quality decision making to facilitate success and who promotes a team-oriented and open-door environment that is conducive to a successful staff.

experience.title: HR Professional
responsibilities: Responded to and resolved employee and leader inquiries regarding benefits, payroll, HR policies, and general transactions via phone, email, and face-to-face interactions.
Acted as first point of contact for employee/manager questions, confirming employment with external agencies and liaising with third parties.
Trained new employees on procedures and policies.
Handled highly sensitive and confidential information, acting as liaison between customers and second-level support.
Assisted employees with leave matters, including short-term and long-term disability, resignations, and work environment issues.
Documented inquiries and resolutions in the HRMS database for future reference.
Escalated complex issues to team leaders or specialists as appropriate.
Processed HR and payroll transactions, ensuring accuracy of employee levels, pay, and benefits.

experience.title: HR Assistant
responsibilities: Trained under senior management to create HR policies and procedures.
Recruited employees and managed group benefits databases.
Developed orientation, training, and incentive programs.
Managed leave-of-absence programs and personnel records.
Administered benefits enrollment and HR budget.
Facilitated criminal background checks and employee rewards programs.
Updated key HR metrics using HRMS reporting tools.

experience.title: Client/Advisor Professional
responsibilities: Assisted advisors and clients with processing and maintaining financial products and services.
Provided guidance on consumer lending products and other financial offerings.
Collaborated with intra-company teams to complete customer cases and product offerings.
Guided advisors and clients through estate settlement, ownership changes, marital status changes, and beneficiary changes.

experience.title: Personal Banker
responsibilities: Provided customer assistance for personal, business, and consumer lending products.
Collaborated with partners in private banking, insurance, mortgage, investment, and retirement to increase solutions and profits.
Coached tellers and customer representatives to maximize service and sales solutions.
Improved branch customer satisfaction scores and achieved successful survey outcomes.
Originated, opened, and maintained consumer loans.
